create_DummyClassifier_baseline: create a DummyClassifier baseline with the prior strategy to compare against complex classifiers
test_DummyClassifier_strategies: test the DummyClassifier with most_frequent, stratified, uniform, and constant prediction strategies
build_DummyRegressor_quantile: build a DummyRegressor using the quantile strategy to predict a specified quantile of training targets
review_DummyClassifier_predict_proba: review the DummyClassifier predict_proba method that returns empirical class prior probabilities
summarize_DummyRegressor_fit: summarize the DummyRegressor fit method that computes mean, median, quantile, or constant predictions
